checks.reason: Testbench inserted an extra falling-edge wait after a mid-sequence reset, skipping observation of the next rising edge.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
Simulation checks a finite 2048-cycle sequence with repeated synchronous resets and between-edge reset pulses; it does not exhaust the full LFSR period.

justified_tb_changes.change: Deassert mid-sequence reset after the checked rising edge without waiting an extra falling edge.
justified_tb_changes.justification: The original extra falling-edge wait caused the next iteration to skip a rising edge and compare stale expected state. All expected values and checks are retained.
